generator: For each permutation (a,b,c,d), multiply the first k factors E_ab(x0) E_bc(x1) E_cd(x2) E_da(x3), where E_ij(x)=I+x e_ij and each x is rational. The polynomial path expansion classifies every rational support cell by the zero-edge mask and, when all edges are nonzero, whether their product is -1.
